purpose: Compact live-cash anchor families; not proprietary charts and not exact equilibrium frequencies.

baseline_assumptions.table_size: 8-9 handed nominal; shorten by position remap when fewer players are dealt in
baseline_assumptions.rake_model: high-capped live sensitivity; room-specific rake must be checked
baseline_assumptions.straddle: off in baseline; translate all stacks and sizes into straddle units when on
baseline_assumptions.mixing_policy: pure core plus explicit flex band; no RNG required at table

A1_unopened_pot.memory_cue: Position first; open the core, then add or remove one edge band.

A2_limped_pot_iso.memory_cue: Value density first; add isolation bluffs only when folds or position make them real.
A2_limped_pot_iso.size_ip: 4.5bb plus 1bb per additional limper; add 1-2bb only when calls are very inelastic
A2_limped_pot_iso.size_oop: 5.5bb plus 1bb per additional limper; preserve room to fold marginal flex hands
reject_first: small suited hands when effective depth is short

A3_facing_open.memory_cue: Price, opener zone, players behind, position, then line.

bb_vs_btn_2_5_to_3x.remove_first_vs_4x: weak offsuit kings/queens, bottom suited gappers, lowest offsuit connectors

sb_default.rule: 3-bet or fold is the default; flat only as an explicit protected overlay.
flat_overlay_requires: hand benefits more from call than 3-bet

ip_vs_open.rule: Keep pairs and suited hands that realise; 3-bet value and blocker candidates; fold dominated offsuit first.
ip_vs_open.players_behind_penalty: remove small pairs and low suited connectors before removing high-card suited hands

A4_facing_three_bet.memory_cue: Who can 3-bet wide, who is value-heavy, and which hands realise as calls?

tight_ep_configuration.bluff_permission: A5s-A4s only with evidence of wide 3-bet and real folds

late_vs_blind.fold_first: KJo,QJo,ATo and other dominated offsuit hands

oop_vs_ip.rule: call less and protect the calling range with hands that can continue across runouts

size_rule_100bb.note: geometry anchor only; exact room/open-size calibration remains pending

A5_squeeze_and_polar.memory_cue: Purify candidates; do not invent bluffs.

size_rule.one_caller_ip: 3x the open plus one open-size unit for the caller
size_rule.one_caller_oop: 4x the open plus one open-size unit for the caller
size_rule.two_callers_ip: 3x the open plus one open-size unit per caller
size_rule.two_callers_oop: 4x the open plus one open-size unit per caller
size_rule.deep_or_very_sticky: add 0.5-1 open-size unit, not random fixed big-blind padding

vs_late_open.reject: hands chosen only because they look too weak to call

polar_four_bet_selector.secondary_candidates: A3s-A2s when blocker and fold-target logic remain intact
polar_four_bet_selector.rare_candidates: KTs-K9s only when the 3-bettor folds KQ/KJ-type hands and does not flat too widely
polar_four_bet_selector.not_candidates: 98s/87s when they realise well as calls; offsuit junk; hands dominated by the call branch
polar_four_bet_selector.required_target: a credible set of better hands that fold, plus a narrow enough continue/5-bet region

open_size.2.5x: add one flex band in position and BB
open_size.4x: remove one flex band; dominated offsuit hands leave first
open_size.5x_plus: continue mainly core; treat speculative calls as explicit deep-stack decisions

depth.50bb: linearise 3-bet/4-bet, reduce speculative flats and small-pair implied-odds calls
depth.200bb: add IP suited/pair calls, preserve protected flats, reduce OOP automatic stack-offs
depth.400bb: prioritise nut potential and position; sharply penalise dominated offsuit and OOP one-pair commitment

rake.R2_high_5pct_or_uncertain_cap: remove marginal calls first; prefer fold or value-led raise over dominated flats

players_behind.aggressive_squeezer: remove weakest flats and promote only true top flex candidates to 3-bet
players_behind.multiple_live_callers: increase value density and sizing; do not widen with random suited hands

straddle.rule: divide every stack and raise size by the straddle; rebuild the node in straddle units
straddle.example: $600 at 1/3 with $6 straddle is 100 straddles, not 200 big blinds
